miurla/morphic|lib/models/fetch-models.t.note: fetch-models.ts:179 is a raw fetch GET to https://api.openai.com/v1/models that lists models for the selector. The rubric counts raw HTTP only to generation endpoints (and models.list only as an SDK call), so this is not an inventory site. The tool's 'kept' is harmless but counts a site that should not be there.

fetch-models.ts:211-220 pages through GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models via fetchJson for model discovery. That is not a generation endpoint, so under the raw-HTTP counting rule it is not a site and the tool's entry is a false positive.
